item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 31/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will persist over southern China this week. Tropical Cyclone Nalgae is expected to move towards the northern part of the South China Sea and edge closer to the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Under the combined effect of Nalgae and the northeast monsoon, it will be windy and there will be swells over the coastal areas in the next couple of days. The outer rainbands associated with Nalgae will also bring squally showers to the region midweek this week. Besides, the area of low pressure over the western North Pacific will bring unsettled weather to the region in the next couple of days and move towards the vicinity of the seas east of the Philippines.
